lines: Shiva once gave a demon the power to burn anyone to ash. With one touch.
Shiva once gave a demon the power to burn anyone to ash, with one touch.
The demon tried it on Shiva, first.
The demon tried it on Shiva first.
Pleased, Shiva offered him any boon.
Let whoever I touch on the head... burn to ash.
Let whoever I touch on the head burn to ash.
And his hand reached straight for Shiva!
And his hand reached straight for Shiva.
Vishnu saw it, and became Mohini.
The most beautiful dancer in all the worlds.
The power you beg for, can be the thing that ends you.
The power you beg for can be the thing that ends you.
